claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials from both countries meet on sidelines: In his address, the US president pondered whether a peace deal would be agreed or whether he would have to take extreme action against Iran.
- Burnham expects to find 'common ground' with Trump in first meeting: In New York, the prime minister will also deliver a speech to the UN General Assembly expected to be focused on AI.
- US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.
- How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.
- Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings: Three churches and three luxury hotels were targeted in the 2019 attacks which killed 270.
- Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak: Scientists say the developing El Niño is now the strongest on record with weather impacts already being felt around the world.
- Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list: Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman both have close ties to President Putin, and Kyiv said the move sent Moscow the wrong signals.
- Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to investigate juror and check his phone: The attorney wants the court to look at the juror's mobile phone use and answers on questionnaires.
- US judge blocks deportation of DoorDash driver shot by ICE: The delivery driver was transferred from a hospital to a detention centre after the shooting on Sunday.
- Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school: Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.
- Top South African policeman charged with sexual offences: Shadrack Sibiya, who has made no comment, is alleged to have groomed a 16-year-old and raped an 18-year-old.
- Autopsy shows Hayden Panettiere died from a drug overdose: The death of the child star - who had fentanyl, Xanax, a muscle relaxant and antipsychotic medication in her system - was ruled an accident.
